title: Define safe multi-distribution adapter contract
outcome: Separate distro-independent migration intent from distribution-specific package and service behaviour, with runtime init detection and fail-closed mutation policy.
scope: Add one adapter metadata record for each curated distro recommender profile
Require runtime PID 1 detection for multi-init distributions
Disable package, service and reboot mutations by default
Use primary distro documentation for init-system claims
exclusions: No repository changes or OS upgrades
No OS installation, partitioning, bootloader changes or reboot
No claim of independent review or physical/VM validation
acceptance: All seven recommender profiles have exactly one adapter metadata entry
MX Linux, Debian and antiX do not infer active init solely from distro name
All profiles remain candidate-only and all mutations default to disabled
Unit tests cover profile completeness and fail-closed safety policy
CI evidence is recorded before acceptance
evidence_required: Unit test output or GitHub Actions run
